section.paragraph: The people and the organizations behind Exponential.
Exponential is open source software, developed by the Exponential Foundation together with 7x and a community of developers and editors around the world.
The foundation looks after the platform: its code, its releases, its license and its community.
The Exponential Foundation keeps Exponential free and open. It plans releases, reviews contributions, publishes security fixes and maintains the documentation and the help center.
Exponential is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later. Anyone can use it, study it, change it and share it.

section.paragraph: 7x develops Exponential and offers hosting, support and training for the sites built with it.

7x is the team that writes most of the code of Exponential today. Its engineers build the kernel, the application server Velocity, the designs and the extensions, and they run sites for customers who want the platform managed for them.
Visit se7enx.com to learn more.
More than twenty-five years of publishing on the web, and still moving forward.

The platform began in 1999 as eZ Publish, created by eZ Systems in Norway, and grew into one of the best-known open source content management systems. When its original maker discontinued it, the community kept it alive.
Today it continues as Exponential: maintained by the Exponential Foundation and 7x, running on current PHP versions and modern servers, and still able to run the sites built on its earlier versions.
Questions about Exponential, our services or a project you have in mind? Send us a message and we will get back to you within one business day.

section.paragraph: Everything a modern content team needs, in one open source platform you own.

Exponential 6.0.15 brings editing to the page itself, a fast application server, visual layouts and support for five databases, while keeping the content model that thousands of sites have trusted for over two decades.
Editors change text, images and layouts where visitors see them, with drafts, previews and versions one click away.

The website sidebar of expwt puts every page action next to the content: edit, create, move, sort, translate and publish without leaving the page you are looking at. Fields can be edited in place, and every change is a draft until you publish it.

li.paragraph: Drafts, previews and a full version history for every page
Workflow states and roles decide who may publish what
Autosave keeps work safe while you type
The image picker and the image editor are part of the flow

section.paragraph: Nothing here needs a separate administration screen, yet the full administration interface is always there for structural work.

ezobject:attribute.name: Title
ezobject:attribute.text: Velocity: an application server built for speed

section.paragraph: Exponential Velocity keeps the system warm in memory and answers requests in milliseconds, with HTTPS built in.
Velocity runs Exponential as a persistent application server. The kernel, settings and templates are loaded once and shared by a pool of workers, so each request starts with everything ready.

li.paragraph: Persistent workers with a dynamic pool that grows with traffic
A response cache that serves repeat visits instantly
Certificates managed for you, with live renewal
A configuration layout that system administrators already know

section.paragraph: Velocity runs next to PHP-FPM and Apache, so you can move one site at a time.

section.paragraph: Compose landing pages from blocks and zones, reuse headers and footers everywhere, and change a layout without a developer.
Exponential Layouts brings visual page composition to every site. Layouts are made of zones; zones hold blocks such as text, images, lists of content, galleries and calls to action.

li.paragraph: Shared layouts carry headers, footers and banners across the site
Rules decide which layout a section, a content type or a single page uses
Every block can be previewed and published on its own schedule

ezobject:attribute.name: Image
ezobject:attribute.alternative-text: Illustration of a page layout grid

section.paragraph: Run Exponential on SQLite, MySQL or MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or Oracle, and move between them when your needs change.

The same content, the same templates and the same extensions run on every supported database. Start a prototype on SQLite with no server at all, grow on MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL, or fit into an enterprise landscape with Oracle or MongoDB.
Installation, upgrades and the site packages are tested on each engine, so the choice of database is a business decision, not a rewrite.

section.paragraph: Two-factor sign-in, re-authentication for sensitive actions and pages ready for a strict Content Security Policy.

Exponential protects accounts with two-factor authentication and asks editors to verify it is really them before sensitive changes. The designs load every script and stylesheet as files, so a site can run under a Content Security Policy without exceptions.

li.paragraph: "Verify it's you" before account and permission changes
Form tokens against cross-site request forgery
Roles and policies down to a single section or content type

section.paragraph: Exponential UI replaces legacy JavaScript with accessible, themeable components and modern browser features.

The administration interface and the site designs share one modern foundation: native dialogs, date pickers, sortable tables and uploads with progress, all keyboard accessible, translated and themeable with design tokens, in light and dark mode.
Designs are responsive from the smallest phone to wide desktop screens, and every page is built to meet WCAG 2.2 AA.

section.paragraph: Translate content into any language, switch the interface to one of dozens of locales and publish sites for every market.

Every piece of content can exist in as many languages as you need, with fallbacks for what is not translated yet. The interface itself is available in dozens of locales, and the help center explains the system in English and German.
The help center explains every feature step by step, and the community and 7x are there when you need a person.

section.paragraph: How organizations use Exponential to publish, sell and share.
From corporate websites to newsrooms, intranets and online stores: one platform, shaped by its content model to the way you work.
A site that speaks with one voice across brands, countries and languages.
Structured content, shared layouts and translation workflows keep every page on brand, while local teams publish what matters in their market.
Newsrooms publish fast and often, with scheduling, versions and lists that update themselves.
Articles, galleries, events and feeds are first-class content. Editors schedule publication, reuse content across channels and keep a full history of every change.
Sell products next to the stories that make people want them.
Products, prices, options, baskets and orders are part of the content model, so a product page can be as rich as any article.
Share knowledge with employees and partners, each seeing what they may see.
Sections, roles and policies control access down to a single page, and sign-in can use two-factor authentication.
